profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary:
I am blessed to have earned a B.S. in Computer Science with a minor in Cybersecurity from New York University. I'm dedicated to promoting diversity and supporting minorities in STEM fields. My goal is to be a positive influence on others, both personally and professionally. As a skilled software developer, I'm proficient in a wide range of programming languages and tools such as the following. 

Languages: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, Groovy, C#, C++, Python, XML
Tools: Spring/Spring Boot, Angular, React, Node, Bootstrap, Docker, Git/Github, Maven, Jenkins
Testing: JUnit, Jasmine, Karma, Protractor, Selenium
Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL
Persistence: Hibernate
Methodologies: Agile, TDD, ATDD, Paired Programming, Responsive Web Design, REST

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing and improving software on Scifinder-n, one of CAS's flagship products, using Java, Spring, TypeScript, Angular, and MongoDB. Contributing scalable code following Agile methodologies with Unit Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, and Acceptance Testing.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Completed a comprehensive six-week course in Agile programming, instructed by Chris Judd. Covered enterprise tools including IntelliJ, Maven, Git, and Jenkins for continuous integration. Developed a real-world product for resource management, called STAR - some technologies used were Spring, Spring Security, Spring MVC, HTML, JavaScript, Angular, React, Node, Jasmine, Bootstrap, CSS, and Cucumber/Ruby. Worked within a strict Agile environment - divided into six one-week iterations, starting each day with a stand-up meeting, keeping big visuals to track progress, working with partners for paired programming, receiving code reviews, ending iterations with retrospectives, and practicing strong Test-Driven Development (TDD) using powerful tools that include JUnit and Mockito. Used Ruby to run Cucumber with Watir and Page Object for highly expressive Acceptance Testing. Exposure to web security, accessibility, client and server performance.

positions.title: Greenhouse Assistant
positions.description: My responsibility was to prepare plants for commercial and retail distribution. I had to water, trim, and packages plants while meeting time constraints. I learned the tasks and duties of different departments in the company. Consequently, I was utilized in different departments depending on their workload. An example of this meant working in the warehouse one week organizing the product for storage by weighing, counting, and re-packing it. Then working in the dock the following week keeping the conveyor belt moving smoothly and preparing the product for shipment.

positions.title: Machine Operator
positions.description: I was hired for 12 hour night shifts four days a week. I was in charge of operating 10 milling machines ensuring they ran optimally throughout the night. I produced 3,300 parts on a daily basis ensuring each part met the required specifications. I learned the job very quickly and began performing supervisor-level tasks. These tasks included replacing tools inside the machine if parts were not up to specifications. Modifying the machine's programming to adjust cutting measurements. Due to my initiative, I was considered for promotion to supervisor within 4 months.

positions.title: Student Library Supervisor
positions.description: I started off as a front desk worker and was promoted within one year to student supervisor through my exemptional performance, punctuality, and people skills. My main duties as a student supervisor were to train and supervise more than 10 front desk workers while also ensuring the proper distribution of resources. This involved keeping track of all issues including finding books, late fines, printer network issues, and library rules. I gained experience as a leader and how to best resolve issues with workers, clients, and upper management.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: I was in charge of maintaining and publishing website content for Thirdspace. Thirdspace is a student-run medical online journal at Harvard Medical School. I worked as their sole front-end web developer and used Drupal as the content management system to publish various types of medical-related articles, interviews, and visual arts. I used minimal HTML and CSS to customize page layouts and content display. I handled database and resource management through GoDaddy's services.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: I managed the distribution of resources to students such as loaner keys, packages, and other resource center services. I interacted with many students on a daily basis and met each of their concerns, questions, and resource center needs. That included helping them find their mail, how to get their packages and food recommendations. I became skilled at having responsible, genuine communication with students from all types of backgrounds.

company.name: Residential Life and Housing Services NYU

positions.title: Front Desk Staff
positions.description: I managed gym sign-ins to check for active memberships. I ensured every client abided by gym rules such as wearing appropriate attire and appropriately using gym equipment. I built many meaningful relationships with regular clients and made sure everyone's experience at the gym was ideal.

positions.title: Student Tutor
positions.description: I taught math and reading to elementary students at a public school in Brooklyn. I worked with 3 to 4 students at a time and gave hands-on solutions to identify their strengths and help develop their weaknesses. I provided guidance and mentorship to students as well. I encouraged them to do their best in school and achieve higher education.

positions.title: Deboning Production Team Member
positions.description: I handled cutting and cleaning raw full turkey into smaller portions such as thighs and wings. It required fast learning of precise and calculated cuts as the turkeys were carried quickly by an overhead conveyor system. Although I was brought on as a temporary hire, I was offered full-time employment with higher pay and benefits for my quick ability to adapt and high work rate. I turned down the offer as I was a full-time student at New York University and only working there for winter break.

positions.title: Maintenance Assistant
positions.description: I worked in different areas of apartment maintenance such as carpentry, painting, plumbing, and electrical. I picked up a lot of valuable knowledge from each of these specific fields as I worked on the job. Most importantly, I learned to perform effectively and efficiently in a team. (worked in groups of four)

positions.title: Busser
positions.description: I provided excellent customer service by sanitizing tables, removing excess plates, and accommodating customers' additional requests. I developed the ability to work optimally in a high-paced, high-stress work environment. Often receiving premium tips ($20+) from customers for my exemplary service.

positions.title: Kitchen Assistant
positions.description: I washed, cut, and prepared vegetables and meats for the kitchen chef. I acquired adequate kitchen skills such as kitchen organization, proper rinsing, and proper cutting. I also gained an insightful view of restaurant business management.

projects.title: Premier League Soccer App
projects.description: As a huge soccer fan I wanted to created a web application that followed the Premier League. It keeps track of the current standings, stats, games and presents them nicely so you can follow along.  You can even favorite your teams and It'll show you info for only those teams. I built it using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Python and Django. I Implemented a RESTful API for retrieving the soccer information and integrated a third-party API to keep the stats up to date. I used Postgres as the database for storing favorite teams. Deployed the project on a Heroku virtual container.

projects.title: Marvel API
projects.description: A web page for searching and displaying characters in the Marvel Universe. It was created using React, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It integrates the Marvel Comics API at Marvel.com.
